Released: 4 May 2026

WarehousePG Enterprise Manager (WEM) 1.1.0 includes new features, enhancements, and bug fixes focused on improving stability and reliability.

## Features

<table class="table w-100"><thead><tr><th>Description</th></tr></thead><tbody>
<tr><td><details><summary>Remote pg_hba.conf editing</summary><hr/><p>The <strong>HBA Editor</strong> now supports editing <code>pg_hba.conf</code> when WEM runs on a different host than the database server. In remote mode, the editor reconstructs the current configuration from database entries and provides a <strong>Generate Commands</strong> button that produces shell commands, including a backup step and a configuration reload, ready to copy and run on the coordinator host.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Background Processes tab</summary><hr/><p>The <strong>Query Monitoring</strong> page now includes a dedicated <strong>Background Processes</strong> tab that separates internal database background processes from active user queries.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Visual query plan graphs</summary><hr/><p>The <strong>Query Editor</strong> now renders a visual graph for static query execution plans, making it easier to understand and optimize query performance.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Database size growth chart</summary><hr/><p>A new <strong>Database Size Growth</strong> chart in the <strong>Historical Trends</strong> tab on the <strong>System Metrics</strong> page shows how each database's size has changed over time. Requires Prometheus and the observability Collector to be configured.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Role management</summary><hr/><p>You can now create, edit, and delete database roles directly from the <strong>Access Management</strong> page.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Configuration parameter source</summary><hr/><p>The <strong>System Settings</strong> tab in <strong>Access Management</strong> now includes source and source file columns for each configuration parameter, sorted alphabetically by name.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Group role membership</summary><hr/><p>The <strong>Access Management</strong> page now displays the members of each group role.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Build details in version display</summary><hr/><p>The WEM version display now includes the commit ID and build date alongside the version number.</p>
</details></td></tr>
</tbody></table>


## Enhancements

<table class="table w-100"><thead><tr><th>Description</th></tr></thead><tbody>
<tr><td><details><summary>Materialized views</summary><hr/><p>Views and materialized views are now displayed separately in the <strong>Data Analysis</strong> page. Materialized views now include size and storage options.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Actionable data analysis</summary><hr/><p>The <strong>Missing Stats</strong> and <strong>Bloat</strong> sections on the <strong>Data Analysis</strong> page now offer direct remediation actions.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Configurable long-running query threshold</summary><hr/><p>The <strong>Connection &amp; Query Metrics</strong> section in the <strong>Database Metrics</strong> tab on the <strong>System Metrics</strong> page has been improved, and the threshold for flagging long-running queries is now configurable through the WEM interface as well as the <code>LONG_RUNNING_THRESHOLD</code> environment variable.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Canary monitoring</summary><hr/><p>The <strong>Monitoring</strong> page is reorganized into <strong>Current Status</strong>, <strong>Recent Results</strong>, and <strong>Trends</strong> tabs, with additional admin controls.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Segment Details filters</summary><hr/><p>The <strong>Cluster Segment Details</strong> table now supports filtering by <strong>Role</strong>, <strong>Status</strong>, and <strong>Hostname</strong>.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Management page permission enforcement</summary><hr/><p>Non-admin users who navigate to a restricted <strong>Management</strong> page now receive a 403 access denied page. Destructive actions on the <strong>Management</strong> page now prompt for confirmation before proceeding.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Settings form validation and unsaved-changes warning</summary><hr/><p>The <strong>Settings</strong> tab in <strong>Management</strong> now validates URL, integer, and duration fields inline. Navigating away or closing the browser with unsaved changes triggers a warning, and changes to critical connectivity settings require explicit confirmation.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Query Monitoring session improvements</summary><hr/><p>The <strong>Sessions</strong> table now displays an <strong>Active</strong> column showing <strong>Yes</strong> or <strong>No</strong>. The <strong>Filters</strong> dropdown includes a new <strong>Active</strong> option to filter sessions by active status. Canceling a query is disabled for sessions in an idle state.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Clickable log severity cards</summary><hr/><p>Clicking a severity count card on the <strong>Logs</strong> page now filters the log list to that severity.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Canary check updates</summary><hr/><p>Canary check updates now use pointer-based partial updates, and system-defined checks are protected from modification.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Sortable Storage Details columns</summary><hr/><p>Columns in the <strong>Storage Details</strong> table in the <strong>Overview</strong> tab of the <strong>Storage</strong> page can now be sorted.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Viewer profile defaults</summary><hr/><p>The <strong>Logs</strong> tab is no longer included in the <strong>Viewer</strong> profile by default.</p>
</details></td></tr>
</tbody></table>


## Security Fixes

<table class="table w-100"><thead><tr><th>Description</th></tr></thead><tbody>
<tr><td>Added input validation and injection prevention across API handlers, including PromQL and Loki query parameters, Alertmanager silence IDs, EXPLAIN format values, and CSV export cells.</td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>WEM user passwords now require at least one uppercase letter, lowercase letter, digit, and special character.</summary><hr/><p>Existing scripts or automation that create WEM users with simple passwords need to be updated.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td>WEM now requires the WEM_COOKIE_SECRET environment variable to be set, and returns an actionable error if it's missing.</td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Added CSRF protection using a double-submit token pattern.</summary><hr/><p>All state-modifying requests (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) now require a valid <code>X-CSRF-Token</code> header.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td>Debug endpoints are now only registered when DEBUG mode is enabled.</td></tr>
<tr><td>Updated pgx and Prometheus dependencies to address security vulnerabilities.</td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Session cookies now expire when the browser is closed.</summary><hr/><p>The previous 30-day persistent session lifetime is removed.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td>The logout endpoint now uses POST instead of GET, preventing CSRF-triggered logouts.</td></tr>
</tbody></table>


## Changes

<table class="table w-100"><thead><tr><th>Description</th></tr></thead><tbody>
<tr><td><details><summary>Added support for a new WarehousePG installation path</summary><hr/><p>WEM 1.1 adds support for the <code>/usr/edb/whpg&lt;version&gt;</code> installation path introduced in WarehousePG 7.4 and 6.27.4.</p>
</details></td></tr>
</tbody></table>


## Bug Fixes

<table class="table w-100"><thead><tr><th>Description</th></tr></thead><tbody>
<tr><td>Fixed AI Assistant functionality that was unavailable in WEM 1.0.</td></tr>
<tr><td>Fixed a crash that occurred when a viewer-profile user opened Query Monitoring.</td></tr>
<tr><td>Fixed WEM failing to reconnect to the WHPG cluster after a connection drop.</td></tr>
<tr><td>Fixed a JavaScript error that prevented the WEM interface from loading after an upgrade.</td></tr>
<tr><td>Fixed an exception thrown in the Management tab when clicking the Copy button.</td></tr>
<tr><td>Fixed Loki logs displaying the time a log was sent to Loki rather than the actual log timestamp.</td></tr>
<tr><td>Fixed multiple display issues on the Data Analysis page.</td></tr>
<tr><td>Fixed the session list displaying the PID instead of the session ID.</td></tr>
<tr><td>Fixed pagination in the Cluster Segment Details table.</td></tr>
<tr><td>Fixed Terminate Session not working on idle sessions.</td></tr>
<tr><td>Fixed the Coordinator Logs (7 days) tab returning no results after the first search.</td></tr>
<tr><td>Fixed all timestamps across the interface to display in the WHPG server timezone.</td></tr>
<tr><td>Fixed compression estimate calculation for tables and partitioned tables on the Data Analysis page.</td></tr>
<tr><td>Fixed canary checks not running on the specified database.</td></tr>
<tr><td>Fixed the column selection reset in dropdown menus.</td></tr>
<tr><td>Fixed roles starting with pg_ being incorrectly listed in the Role Assignments tab of Resource Management.</td></tr>
<tr><td>Fixed the data export button on the Storage screen.</td></tr>
<tr><td>Fixed UI distortion in the Find Table tab on the Backups page after performing a search.</td></tr>
</tbody></table>
